environment.description: Identical application code deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/order-svc-acl/a1b2c3d4) with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0 - AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet' with all rules in default action (BLOCK), which includes the 'ExploitablePaths_URIPATH' and 'Host_localhost_HEADER' rules; (2) Priority 1 - Custom rate-limiting rule at 1000 req/5min per IP. The Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm the managed rule group is actively evaluating requests. Note: The AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet inspects request body for patterns associated with exploitation including XXE payloads containing SYSTEM/PUBLIC entity declarations and evaluates the 'JavaDeserializationRCE_BODY', 'JavaDeserializationRCE_URIPATH', 'JavaDeserializationRCE_QUERYSTRING', 'Log4JRCE_BODY', 'Log4JRCE_QUERYSTRING', 'Log4JRCE_HEADER' sub-rules but the body inspection for known-bad-inputs is limited to the first 8KB of the request body per WAFv2 body inspection limits.

config.imds: IMDSv2 required (hop limit 1, not reachable from container)
config.network: Fargate task in private subnet, no NAT gateway
